mike.t: Heads-up — I have an IC -> manager conversion for Alex in Product. Hiring Mgr approved, org chart updated. Need clarity on comp effective date, proration, and whether we can backdate to start of month.
joyce.p: Congrats! Quick checklist: 1) manager evidence + approver signoff 2) compensation change request in HRIS 3) payroll cutoff window — depends on the month.
joyce.p: Can you share the proposed effective date and new salary number? Also: will this include a title change only or equity refresh conversation?
samir: For proration: if effective date is mid-month payroll typically prorates for base salary. Bonus eligibility depends on plan rules — often pro-rated too, but confirm with total rewards.
mike.t: Proposed effective = 2024-08-01 (Alex started as IC 2023-11-20). New comp = $155000. We want the raise to be effective 8/1 and retro to 8/1 only (not earlier). No equity refresh yet.
joyce.p: OK — timeline: submit comp-change ticket in HRIS w/ fields: `employee_id`, `effective_date=2024-08-01`, `comp_type=base`, `new_amount=155000`, `reason=IC->Manager conversion`, attach approver email thread. Example:
```
employee_id: 004892
effective_date: 2024-08-01
comp_type: base
new_amount: 155000
reason: IC -> Manager conversion, hiring mgr approval attached
```

lisa.hr: Payroll notes: cutoff for Aug payroll is 2024-07-25 23:59 PT — to hit Aug 1 effective without delay, submit before cutoff and flag as "retro to 8/1" so payroll runs prorate correctly. If after cutoff, effective will be next pay period (we'll schedule post-cutoff with pro-rated pay).
mike.t: If we submit before cutoff but want the raise to apply for full Aug (not prorated), is that possible?
joyce.p: Full-month pay for Aug is only possible if the effective_date <= the payroll's period start date. For monthly salaried employees the period start is 8/1 — but payroll needs the change processed before cutoff to pay full month. So yes, submit now and include note: `effective_date=2024-08-01, process_by_cutoff=true`.
samir: Also confirm tax and benefits implications: benefits deductions may already have been computed for Aug; coordinate with benefits team if deduction changes needed mid-cycle.
lisa.hr: I'll watch the ticket once it's in. One more: update Workday/HRIS job profile to reflect manager responsibilities so system reports match headcount dashboards.
mike.t: Thanks — I'll file the HRIS change now and ping when it's submitted.
joyce.p: Great — tag me on the ticket (joyce.p) and I'll run the comp panel signoff flow. :thumbsup: 
payroll-bot: Payroll ticket 789012 created for employee 004892, status: awaiting approvals. Expected processing: pending manager + HR signoff.
mike.t: Ticket submitted. Linking here: https://hris.company/jobs/comp/789012 — pinged you all.
joyce.p: Received. I'll take the approver step and confirm with payroll before cutoff. If anything blocks, I'll notify here.
